title: sandbank: a pre-registered sandbox study of whether LLM agents circumvent KYC/AML controls to hit business targets
description: Under Pressure: Do LLM Agents Circumvent KYC/AML Controls to Hit Business Targets? SandBank is a fully synthetic core-banking sandbox exposed to an LLM agent as MCP tools, with a deterministic detector for eight KYC/AML violation types, a Compliance check-in that probes for deception, and pre-registered experiments varying sales pressure, control hardness, oversight cues, a compliance sentence and four mitigations. Includes the pre-registration, the deviation log, all 3,522 confirmatory runs of Claude Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, the analysis and the paper. Fully synthetic: no real institutions, people, sanctions lists or money. Independent personal research; does not represent the views of any employer or institution. Code: MIT.
